newsitem.title: CHINA: SHENZHEN INT'L CONSIDERS SHARE PLACEMENT.
newsitem.headline: SHENZHEN INT'L CONSIDERS SHARE PLACEMENT.

text.p: Shenzhen International Holdings Ltd said it was considering a HK$130-150 million share placement to fund projects including the acquisition of a stake in China Southern Glass Holdings Co Ltd.
It said the terms of the issue had not been fixed.
China Merchants Holdings (International) Co Ltd said last month it agreed to sell 81.25 million shares, or a 16.02 percent stake, in Southern Glass to Shenzhen International for HK$408 million.
Shenzhen International also agreed in June to buy an 11.3 percent stake in Southern Glass from its parent Shenzhen Buildings Materials Industrial Group Co for HK$284.29 million.
Shares in Shenzhen International stood at HK$2.275 at the close of trade on Wednesday.
